html:
A Byzantine scholar and monk who became the first patriarch of Constantinople under Ottoman rule. He lived from about 1400 to about 1473.

As George Scholarios he was a lay teacher and judge who knew Latin theology well and admired Thomas Aquinas. He went to the Council of Florence and at first backed union with Rome. Back home he changed sides and became the leader of the Greeks who opposed the union.

After the fall of Constantinople in 1453 he was taken captive. Mehmed II had him found, and in January 1454 made him patriarch. The sultan gave him authority over the Orthodox Christians of the empire, the model for how the Ottomans governed religious communities. He also had the last book of his old rival Gemistos Plethon burned for its paganism.
